literal_meaning: তালের ফাঁকে (in the gaps of the rhythm)
figurative_meaning_en: out of others' notice or secretly
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাড়ির লোকের অগোচরে ফাঁকতালে কাজ চালাচ্ছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He's planning it on the sly.
He's carrying out the work out of the family's notice.
note: Origin likely from musical or rhythmic contexts in Bengali folk traditions, implying actions in unnoticed intervals.
